annotations.title: What is near a place on the map

description: Entrances, NPCs, vendors and treasures near a spot, nearest first, with straight-line distances in yards. Give a zone (name or map id) with x and y from 0 to 100, or an NPC id to start from where that NPC stands. Entrances come from the game files; one is confirmed once 3 installs zoned in from it. NPCs, vendors and treasures are player-observed and listed only where 3 installs agree on the position. Zones the files hold back as possibly unreleased are not offered. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected.

npcId.description: Start from this NPC's agreed position instead of a zone and x, y.

zone.description: Zone name or map id, such as Elwynn Forest or 1429. Needs x and y.

name: world_map_near

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

entrances.description: From the game files, found in game files, unconfirmed unless confirmed is set. Nearest first.

confirmed.description: Installs that zoned in from this entrance, once 3 agree on it; absent until then.

npcs.description: Players saw them; a pin needs 3 installs on the same map.

ok.description: False when the query was refused; message says why.

treasures.description: Game objects players saw on the minimap at their own position, such as treasure chests; a pin needs 3 installs at one spot.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: What is near a place on the map
